ghs.en: Miki: "Yamanobe Miki here. We have come!"

ghs.en: Miki: "'Hello' my behind. Give a proper good morning now!"

rows.jp: 「『お』と『よ』と『う』と『い』が小さかった。もう一度！」
rows.en: “Your g, o, m, and i were too small. Again!”

ghs.en: Miki: "The 'g', the 'd', the 'm' and the 'n' where too small. One more time!"

rows.en: Smack! She slaps Kiri on the rear.

rows.jp: 霧は尻に敷かれていた。
rows.en: Miki has Kiri completely under her thumb.

ghs.en: Kiri was being assiduously imposed on by Miki.

rows.en: I want to be under her thumb too.

ghs.en: I wanna be imposed on too.

rows.en: She gives them a little bow too.

ghs.en: She bows her head with a sharp bob.

rows.jp: 美希ちんはやるときはサドだった。
rows.en: When Miki-kins gets serious, she is a sadist.

ghs.en: When it was time to get things done, Miki-chin was sadistic.

rows.jp: 「なんだその辞儀はぁ！　角度が四度も足りてないじゃない―――か―――」
rows.en: “What kind of bow is that?! You're four whole degrees short, aren't―――you―――”

ghs.en: Taichi: "What kind of bow was even thaaat! Isn't the angle 4 degrees insuffiiiiicieeeeent!"

rows.jp: 「……繊細な霧ちんに多大なストレスかけてますから、つつかない方がいいですよ」
rows.en: “...Kiri-kins is sensitive, and this is putting her under a lot of stress. Better not poke at her.”

ghs.en: Miki: "...because delicate little Kiri-chin is under plenty of stress, it is best to avoid picking on her."

rows.jp: ダウンした俺に、美希は教えてくれた。
rows.en: Once I am down for the count, Miki explains.

ghs.en: Miki had told me after I had been downed.

rows.jp: 「あのぅ、お二人ともどうしたんですか？」
rows.en: “Um, what has gotten into you two?”

ghs.en: Misato: "Uhmmm, what might you two be doing here?"

rows.en: “We came to participate in club activities.”

ghs.en: Miki: "We have come to participate in club activities."

rows.jp: 「あ、でも……やっていただくようなことは……」
rows.en: “Oh, but... there isn't really anything I could ask you to do...”

ghs.en: Misato: "Ah, but... letting you do this, that would be..."
ghs.assessment: The Japanese trails off while explaining that there is not really anything for them to do. The English instead frames the problem as permission to let them do an unspecified 'this,' omitting the absence of available work.
ghs.remedy: Ah, but... there isn't really anything for you to do...

highlights.text: letting you do this, that would be

rows.jp: 「あの、その、でも今までずっとサボって……」
rows.en: “Um, well, but you haven't been coming all this time...”

ghs.en: Miki: "Uhm, well, but you have been cutting up until now..."
ghs.assessment: The Japanese says they have been skipping or slacking off from club activities. 'Cutting up' means behaving noisily or mischievously, not being absent.
ghs.remedy: Um, but you've both been skipping club all this time...

highlights.text: you have been cutting up until now

rows.jp: 「わたし一人でやろうと思っていたので、皆さんに来てもらわずとも……」
rows.en: “I was planning to do it alone, so there is no need for all of you to come...”

ghs.en: Misato: "I was thinking I would be doing this alone, without having everyone come in..."

ghs.en: Senpai has a desperate desire to decline.

rows.jp: やはり部活は逃避目的だったか。

Taichi: "It is just as I expected."

rows.jp: 俺の人間観察力は今、限りなく神に近い。

rows.en: “We came to participate in club activities!”

ghs.en: Miki: "We have come to participate in club activitieees!"

rows.en: “There is no point looking away from reality. We have no choice but to rot away here, so let's give up and enjoy the present!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "There are no ways to avoid this, not even averting one's eyes away from reality. All of us will rot away from here, this harmless young boy included, ergo please surrender and enjoy the present!"

rows.jp: 「もー、ほんとうにぺけくんったら」
「……佐倉さんもご一緒なんですか？」

ghs.en: Misato: "...Sakura-san, you shall also help then?"
Kiri: "I-, I have been... forced by Miki..."

rows.en: Kiri straightens up as she speaks.

ghs.en: So said Kiri, straightening up her back.

rows.en: “...Oh, well. I suppose there is no helping it.”

rows.jp: 「じゃあ……手伝ってもらいます……」

ghs.en: Misato: "Then... I shall accept your help..."

rows.jp: 「わーい、学園青春劇ー！　……霧ちん？」
「……わ、わーい……がくえんせいしゅんげきー……はぁ」

ghs.en: Kiri: "...w-, weeee... adolescent school dramaaa... sigh."
Misato: "But once again, why so suddenly..."

rows.jp: 「美希なりの試行錯誤の結果です。まあ、お気になさらず」
rows.en: “The result of Miki's own trial and error. Well, pay it no mind.”

ghs.en: Miki: "It is the result of Miki's trial and error. Well, do not be worried."

ghs.assessment: The Japanese means that the matter is settled. The English is malformed and appears to describe a woman as determined, which is a different proposition.

rows.jp: 「あなたまで参加するわけですね」

ghs.en: Misato: "So even you will participate, then."

rows.en: “Of my own free will, Your Excellency.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "It is due to my personal volition, Your Excellency!"
So I proclaimed with a bow.
ghs.assessment: The Japanese says he announces this while giving a military salute, matching the surrounding soldier routine. A bow is a different gesture and removes that visual continuation.
ghs.remedy: I announced it with a salute.

rows.jp: 「あのぺけくんが、軍人のように！？」

ghs.en: Misato: "Was Peke-kun made into a soldier?!"

rows.jp: 「黒須太一、プロイセン精神を忘れたことは一度もありません」
rows.en: “Taichi Kurosu has never once forgotten the spirit of Prussia.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Kurosu Taichi has never and not for one instant forgot his Prussian soul!"

rows.jp: 「典型的なモンゴロイドじゃないですか」

ghs.en: Misato: "Are you not a prototypical mongoloid?"

rows.jp: 「なにせ日本プロイセンですから」
「日本アルプスと似たようなものですね」

ghs.en: Miki: "It's just like the Japanese Alps isn't it."
Taichi: "It is as your statement says."

rows.jp: 「先輩も霧ちんも、ちゃんといい子にしてますから、バンバン使ってあげてください」
rows.en: “Taichi and Kiri-kins will both behave themselves, so work them as hard as you like.”

ghs.en: Misato: "...so it is... if it has to be like this, then, do this with all your might if you please."

ghs.en: I could see the tip of the antenna.

rows.jp: 先輩はまだ、そこにいた。

ghs.en: Senpai was, once more, still there.

The sound of footsteps from behind.

rows.jp: 「しょーですよー、ごじゆーにー」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Shoo we are, feel free twhoo."
ghs.assessment: The slurred Japanese means roughly 'That's right, be my guest.' The English changes the first clause to a first-person plural statement and is not coherently recoverable as the response.

highlights.text: Shoo we are, feel free twhoo.

rows.jp: 「いやあ、現像できましたよ、アレ」
部活中、美希は写真部の部室でそれをしていた。
rows.en: During club activities, Miki had used the photography club's room to develop them.

ghs.en: Partway through club activities, Miki went to the Photography Club room to do just that.

rows.jp: 「……よく考えたら見せる相手って八人だけじゃないか。俺と君を抜いたら六人だ」
rows.en: “...Come to think of it, there are only eight people to show them to. Excluding you and me, that's six.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...but if I think about it, there's only eight people you can show them to, aren't there. Minus you and me, that's just six."

rows.jp: 「霧ちんと同じことを言いますね。じゃ、部活やめます？」
rows.en: “That is exactly what Kiri-kins said. So, shall we quit the club?”

ghs.en: Miki: "Kiri-chin said the same thing, she did. Well, will you quit club?"

rows.jp: 「……ま、ここまでつきあったし。好きにすれば」
rows.en: “...Well, we've come this far. Do whatever you like.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...bah, I went together with this so far. I'll do as you like."
ghs.assessment: The Japanese tells Miki that, since he has gone along this far, she may do as she likes. The English instead promises that he will act according to her wishes.
ghs.remedy: ...Well, I've gone along with it this far. Do what you like.

rows.jp: 「せんぱいは力持ちですねー」

rows.en: “It's fun watching a man hustle around carrying things. Dragging you into club activities was worth it.”

ghs.en: Miki: "It's so fun to watch a man briskly move things around. It was quite worth it to recruit into the club!"
She did it just for that purpose...

rows.jp: 「その働きぶりまことに天晴れ。田崎商店でジュースおごってあげます」
rows.en: “Your work was truly splendid. I'll buy you a drink at Tazaki Foods.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Your labor performance has been splendid. I shall treat you to juice at the Tasaki Store."
Taichi: "HA. HA. HA. Thank you very much."

rows.jp: 顔が引きつってしまうな。
「ま、やることがあった方がいいか」
rows.en: “Well, I guess having something to do is better.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Well, isn't it good to be busy doing something."

rows.jp: 「細かいことはゆっくり考えればいいしな」
rows.en: “We can take our time thinking through the details.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "It's great that we can think calmly about all the little details, yes."

rows.jp: 「……今週は学園青春ドラマといきましょう」
rows.en: “...This week, let's go with a school coming-of-age drama.”

ghs.en: Miki: "...this week, let us make it a School Adolescent Drama."

rows.jp: 「んー。人類生き残りを求めて男女八人の旅……ですとか」
rows.en: “Hmm. Something like... eight men and women journeying in search of humanity's survivors.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Hmmm. The Voyage of the Eight Men and Women in Search of the Survivors of Mankind... something like that."
These are the times we will live in,

rows.jp: 「けど、俺はここで普通やってるのがいいなぁ」
rows.en: “But I'd rather stay here and carry on as usual.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "But me, I'd rather do normal things here."

rows.jp: 人類の意地をかけて、平常でいてやるのもいいだろう。
rows.en: We could stake humanity's pride on staying normal.

ghs.en: It's probably in the disposition of mankind this preference to do what is usual.
ghs.assessment: The Japanese proposes defiantly maintaining ordinary life for the sake of humanity's pride. The English recasts that deliberate stance as a probable innate human disposition and loses the wager of pride.
ghs.remedy: For the sake of humanity's pride, it might be good to insist on carrying on as normal.

highlights.text: It's probably in the disposition of mankind this preference to do what is usual.

rows.jp: 美希は本当におごってくれた。
rows.en: Miki really does buy me that drink.

rows.jp: 「本当に、普通の日って感じだな」
rows.en: “It really feels like an ordinary day.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "This really feels like a normal day don't it."

rows.jp: 夕日が空に照りはえる。
rows.en: The setting sun shines across the sky.

ghs.en: The sky is aglow in the sunset.

rows.jp: 今が、人類の斜陽だと思い返させた。
rows.en: It reminds me that this moment is humanity's twilight.

ghs.en: Right now, it made my thoughts return to the sun setting over mankind.
